state: Actual selector observations: eighteen corrected existing short summaries, retained English fallbacks, no selected long cache or native-language approval.

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (ar)
records.text: لقاح مصمّم لشخص واحد يحمل تعليمات لتسلسلات مختارة من ورمه. التصميم وحده لا يثبت أن هذه الأهداف تُعرَض أو يجري التعرّف عليها أو أنها مفيدة سريرياً.

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (de)
records.text: Ein für eine Person entworfener Impfstoff liefert Anweisungen für ausgewählte Sequenzen aus ihrem Tumor. Der Entwurf allein belegt weder deren Präsentation und Erkennung noch einen klinischen Nutzen.

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (es)
records.text: Una vacuna diseñada para una persona aporta instrucciones para secuencias seleccionadas de su tumor. El diseño por sí solo no demuestra que esos blancos se presenten, se reconozcan ni tengan utilidad clínica.

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (fr)
records.text: Un vaccin conçu pour une personne fournit des instructions pour des séquences sélectionnées dans sa tumeur. La conception seule ne prouve pas que ces cibles soient présentées, reconnues ou utiles en clinique.

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (hi)
records.text: किसी एक व्यक्ति के लिए बनाया गया टीका उसके ट्यूमर से चुने गए अनुक्रमों के निर्देश देता है। केवल डिज़ाइन से यह सिद्ध नहीं होता कि ये लक्ष्य प्रस्तुत होते हैं, पहचाने जाते हैं या उपचार में उपयोगी हैं।

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (ja)
records.text: 一人のために設計したワクチンは、その人の腫瘍から選んだ配列の情報を含みます。設計だけでは、その標的が提示され、認識され、臨床的に役立つとは示せません。

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (pt)
records.text: Uma vacina concebida para uma pessoa fornece instruções para sequências selecionadas do seu tumor. A concepção, por si só, não demonstra que esses alvos sejam apresentados, reconhecidos ou clinicamente úteis.

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (zh)
records.text: 为一个人设计的疫苗包含其肿瘤中选定序列的指令。仅凭设计不能证明这些靶点已被呈递、得到识别或具有临床价值。

records.name: Personalised neoantigen (mRNA) vaccines (simple)
records.text: A vaccine for one person carries instructions based on selected tumour sequences. That design alone does not show that the targets are displayed, recognised or useful for treatment.

records.name: Neoantigen (simple)
records.text: A changed tumour sequence can make a new protein piece. Immune cells may recognise it, but tests still need to check display, recognition and harm to healthy cells.

records.name: Neoantigen candidate selection (simple)
records.text: A target list should show what is known, what remains untested and which failures the candidates share. A long list or a good computer score does not prove safe tumour recognition.

records.name: mRNA and lipid nanoparticle manufacturing (simple)
records.text: This kind of cancer vaccine is made by producing and cleaning a genetic message, then combining it with material that helps deliver it. The exact product and each batch need their own quality checks.

records.name: Cancer vaccines and oncolytic viruses (simple)
records.text: Cancer vaccines aim to help immune cells recognise cancer targets. Cancer-killing viruses can injure some tumour cells; useful immunity and patient benefit need separate evidence.

records.name: Immune surveillance and cancer immunoediting (simple)
records.text: Immune responses can control cancer and select which populations persist. Immunoediting is a testable framework, not a way to assign a phase or recurrence risk from one scan.

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (ar)
records.text: جهة متعاقدة تنفّذ أعمال تطوير الأدوية أو تصنيعها المتفق عليها لصالح عميل. لا يوضح اسم الخدمة وحده المهام أو أدلة الجودة أو المسؤوليات التي يغطيها اتفاق معيّن.

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (de)
records.text: Ein Auftragsunternehmen übernimmt vereinbarte Arbeiten zur Entwicklung oder Herstellung von Arzneimitteln für einen Kunden. Die Dienstleistungsbezeichnung allein sagt nicht, welche Aufgaben, Qualitätsnachweise oder Verantwortlichkeiten eine konkrete Vereinbarung umfasst.

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (es)
records.text: Una organización contratada realiza el trabajo acordado de desarrollo o fabricación de medicamentos para un cliente. El nombre del servicio no indica por sí solo qué tareas, pruebas de calidad o responsabilidades cubre un acuerdo concreto.

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (fr)
records.text: Un prestataire réalise pour un client les travaux convenus de développement ou de fabrication de médicaments. Le nom du service ne précise pas, à lui seul, les tâches, les preuves de qualité ou les responsabilités couvertes par un accord donné.

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (hi)
records.text: एक अनुबंधित संस्था ग्राहक के लिए दवाओं के विकास या निर्माण के तय किए गए काम करती है। केवल सेवा का नाम यह नहीं बताता कि किसी खास समझौते में कौन से काम, गुणवत्ता प्रमाण या जिम्मेदारियाँ शामिल हैं।

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (ja)
records.text: 顧客から受託し、合意した医薬品の開発・製造業務を行う組織です。サービス名だけでは、個々の契約がどの作業、品質の証拠、責任を含むかは分かりません。

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (pt)
records.text: Uma organização contratada realiza o trabalho acordado de desenvolvimento ou fabricação de medicamentos para um cliente. O nome do serviço, por si só, não informa quais tarefas, evidências de qualidade ou responsabilidades um acordo específico abrange.

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (zh)
records.text: 受托为客户开展约定的药物开发或生产工作。服务名称本身不能说明某份协议涵盖哪些任务、质量证据或责任。

records.name: CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organisation) (simple)
records.text: A contract company does agreed work developing or making medicines for a client. Its service name does not show which jobs, quality checks or responsibilities a particular agreement covers.

records.text: Chance assigns people to different treatment groups. This helps make a fair comparison, but does not guarantee identical groups or complete follow-up.

records.name: RNA (ar)
records.text: نسخة عمل من جين تُصنع عندما تحتاج الخلية إلى استخدامه. إذا كان DNA هو المكتبة الأم، فإن RNA هو النسخة المصورة التي تُحمل إلى ورشة العمل.

records.name: RNA (de)
records.text: Eine Arbeitskopie eines Gens, die angefertigt wird, wenn die Zelle es benutzen muss. Wenn die DNA die Hauptbibliothek ist, ist die RNA die Fotokopie, die man in die Werkstatt mitnimmt.

records.name: RNA (es)
records.text: Una copia de trabajo de un gen, hecha cuando la célula necesita usarlo. Si el ADN es la biblioteca maestra, el ARN es la fotocopia que se lleva al taller.

records.name: RNA (fr)
records.text: Une copie de travail d'un gène, fabriquée lorsque la cellule a besoin de l'utiliser. Si l'ADN est la bibliothèque de référence, l'ARN est la photocopie emportée à l'atelier.

records.name: RNA (hi)
records.text: किसी जीन की कार्यशील प्रतिलिपि, जो तब बनती है जब कोशिका को उसका उपयोग करना होता है। यदि DNA मुख्य पुस्तकालय है, तो RNA वह फोटोकॉपी है जो कार्यशाला में ले जाई जाती है।

records.name: RNA (ja)
records.text: 細胞が遺伝子を使う必要が生じたときに作られる、その遺伝子の作業用コピーである。DNAが元本を収めた図書館だとすれば、RNAは作業場に持ち込むコピーに当たる。

records.name: RNA (pt)
records.text: Uma cópia de trabalho de um gene, feita quando a célula precisa usá-lo. Se o DNA é a biblioteca principal, o RNA é a fotocópia levada para a oficina.

records.name: RNA (zh)
records.text: 基因的工作副本，在细胞需要使用该基因时制作。如果说DNA是总馆藏，RNA就是带到工作间去的复印件。

records.name: RNA (simple)
records.text: RNA is a working copy of a gene made when the cell needs to use it, like a photocopy taken from the DNA library to the workshop.
